'''Captain Cyllene''' (Japanese: '''シマボシ''' ''Shimaboshi'') is the leader of the [[Galaxy Team]]'s Survey Corps.

She bears a striking resemblance to [[Cyrus]], the leader of [[Team Galactic]] of the modern day, but the relationship between the two, if any, is unknown.

==In the core series games==
{{incomplete|section}}
Cyllene first meets the player at the Wallflower, having heard [[Professor Laventon|Professor Laventon’s]] request to let the player work for the Galaxy Team’s Survey Corps in exchange for food and shelter, which she will accept if they pass a trial the next day. After Laventon, the player, and Akari/Rei finish their meal, she comes back out from inside the Wallflower and gives the player shelter for the night, although she warns that failure to pass the trial will cause them to be expelled from the village.

As the Survey Corps' captain, her primary purpose is to oversee the progress of the player's [[Pokédex]] and increase their rank whenever enough research points have been obtained.

==In the TCG==
[[File:CylleneAstralRadiance183.jpg|200px|thumb|Full Art print of Cyllene]]
{{main|Cyllene (Astral Radiance 138)}}
'''Cyllene''' was introduced as a {{TCG|Supporter card}} in the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]] during the English Sword & Shield Series (the Japanese Sword & Shield Era). It was first released in the Japanese {{TCG|Battle Region}} subset and the English {{TCG|Astral Radiance}} expansion, with artwork by [[nagimiso]]. It was also released as a {{TCG|Full Art card}} and {{TCG|Secret card}} in the same Japanese and English expansions, with artwork by the same artist. It allows the player to flip two coins, then put a card up from their discard pile on top of their deck for each heads flipped.
{{-}}

==Trivia==
* Cyllene is shown to have a fear of bugs, as she screams when a {{p|Wurmple}} wanders into her office.
* After defeating [[Zisu]]'s fourth team in Path of Tenacity, she mentions that Cyllene was one of the best swordswomen in [[Hoenn]].<ref name="origins"/>
* In a discussion between Cyllene and [[Kamado]], Kamado suggests that the Galaxy Team may eventually disband. Cyllene then vows to pass down the name and accomplishments of the team to her descendants, potentially alluding to the events of [[Team Galactic]] in the modern day.<ref name="descendants">'''[[Cyllene/Quotes|Cyllene]]''': "''I promise you… I will pass down the name of our team, and tales of its accomplishments, to all my '''descendants'''.''" (Emphasis added.)</ref>
* Cyllene coined the term ''[[massive mass outbreak]]''.<ref name="mmo">'''[[Cyllene/Quotes|Cyllene]]''': "''These must be somehow different from the mass outbreaks we know. Why don't we call this new phenomenon... a '''massive mass outbreak'''?''" (Emphasis added.)</ref>
